## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the learner problem, change, and release scope.

## Evidence

List commands actually run and their results. Identify unverified paths.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Synthetic data only; no secrets or confidential customer details.
- [ ] Links, exercises, and expected behavior agree with implementation.
- [ ] Failure behavior is explained or tested where relevant.
- [ ] No extra v0.1 labs, projects, templates, or placeholder folders.
